lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters extending from the posterior margin of the gill slits to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features on the upper third of the flank showing a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance (dorsal) to low luminance (ventral shadow).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters distributed unevenly within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms, including two remoras attached to the ventral-posterior region and a cluster of small fish near the mouth area.
